Job Description: 
 
➢ Manage end-to-end OTC derivative trade life cycle, including pre-settlement, settlement, and 
post-settlement activities. 
➢ Perform trade validation and deal confirmations with clients and counterparties to ensure 
accurate booking and settlement. 
➢ Execute front-to-back trade and post-settlement reconciliations, identifying and resolving 
economic discrepancies. 
➢ Monitor exceptions and aged breaks, coordinating with Front Office, Middle Office, and 
counterparties for timely resolution. 
➢ Handle settlement instructions via SWIFT messaging (MT103, MT202) for EMEA and NY 
markets. 
➢ Perform SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) checks with four-eye control to ensure accuracy 
and compliance. 
➢ Actively support risk exposure management by resolving critical and high-risk outstanding 
breaks. 
➢ Ensure timely and accurate processing of all activities in line with defined SLAs and SOPs. 
➢ Contribute to process efficiency projects, including automation through Excel macros, improving 
turnaround time and accuracy. 
➢ Prepare daily operational reports and support audits, compliance checks, and SOP updates. 
➢ Train and mentor new joiners on derivative settlement processes and controls.
